title: Nvidia’s Singapore unit reports $104B revenue for 2025: FT
summary:
Nvidia's revenue reporting shift may obscure true market dynamics, impacting transparency and potentially influencing stock valuations and strategies.
The post Nvidia’s Singapore unit reports $104B revenue for 2025: FT appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: According to the Financial Times, Nvidia's Singapore unit reported a massive $104 billion in revenue for 2025. summary: Businesses should put tighter controls around artificial intelligence systems as they move beyond answering questions to carrying out tasks and making decisions, according to new guidelines issued by the Artificial Intelligence Association of Hong Kong (AIHK).
